description: Binary counter with eight bit outputs, counting up or down by a step amount taken from a polyphonic input

inputs.text: A trigger here adds the step amount to the count, which wraps around after 255
A trigger here subtracts the step amount from the count, which wraps around below zero
A trigger here sets the count to zero and blocks the next increment for 1ms
Sets the step amount as an eight bit number, one channel per bit, a channel above 1V counting as a one; with nothing patched the step is 1

outputs.text: Carries 10V while that bit of the count is set and 0V while it is clear
Carries all eight bits of the count at once, one channel per bit, 10V for a set bit and 0V for a clear one

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
